# What does this PR do?

Split the combined GDN/GDN2 unit-test job into **two independently scheduled buckets**, with GDN running exclusively on one GB200 x4 runner and GDN2 on H100.

| Bucket under `tests/unit_tests/ssm/` | Cases | Platform | GPUs per runner | Environments |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: | --- |
| `test_gated_delta_net.py` — all GDN module, FLA/TE parallel correctness, and remaining checks | 139 | GB200 only | 4 | dev |
| `test_gated_delta_net2.py` — GDN2 module and parallel correctness | 60 (54 selected in dev) | H100 | 8 | lts, dev |

The shared module-test bodies move into a non-collected helper. All **199 cases** retain their assertions, shapes, seeds, TP/CP layouts, fixtures, parameter IDs, and existing skip/internal markers, except for the dev-only GDN2 parallel quarantine below. The GDN padding comparison adopts the established tolerance described below; other numerical bounds are unchanged. GDN2 cases change their file path; GDN retains its original node IDs and gains `launch_on_gb200`. Its TP/CP layouts fit four workers. The original H100 run used all eight ranks, with additional ranks forming data-parallel replicas; moving GDN to four workers changes that replication. Production code is unchanged.

The H100 recipe schedules GDN2 and the GB200 recipe schedules one dedicated GDN bucket. A scoped exclusion in `find_test_cases.py` keeps GDN out of H100 catch-all buckets; existing child-bucket exclusions prevent duplicate GB200 execution. Other tests marked `launch_on_gb200` retain their existing cross-platform behavior. Both buckets use the latest tag and existing per-platform settings. The pinned legacy suite has no GDN tests.

## Measured behavior

The [original combined H100 job](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/runs/38189023070/job/114618053972) took **55m38s overall**, including **52m17s in pytest**. The GDN-only portion is approximately 32–33 minutes when reconstructed from its logs.

In [run 38284519331](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/runs/38284519331), GDN on four GB200 GPUs took **37m48s overall**, including **32m41s in pytest**, with 118 passed and 21 skipped. GDN2 on H100 passed 44 cases and skipped 16 after an NCCL-timeout retry; its job took 45m30s excluding queue time. These observations do not establish a hardware speedup or a reduction in total workflow duration. Separate buckets allow scheduling independently; runner availability, compilation, and retries affect elapsed time.

## GDN padding tolerance

[Run 38305226282](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/runs/38305226282/job/115006737425) exposed a stale tolerance in the shared `test_gpu_forward_thd_padding_correctness[1-False-1-gdn]` case: rank 0 had 19/245,760 output elements outside `atol=rtol=3e-4`, with maximum absolute difference 0.001953125. The other three ranks passed. Relevant source and the container image were unchanged from the prior passing GB200 execution; this was a numerical assertion failure, not a timeout.

Set **only this GDN padded SBHD-versus-THD comparison** to `atol=rtol=5e-3`, matching the [existing standalone padding test](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/6ffe9f7326ed325ec2c6ee39558f6de0e80de643/tests/unit_tests/ssm/test_gated_delta_net_padding.py#L33). [PR #6851's validation note](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/6851#issuecomment-5455230207) documents intermittent BF16 differences of 0.001953125–0.00390625 and establishes this tolerance for the distinct FLA layouts. The code comment links that precedent. GDN2 keeps its `1e-2` tolerance, and ordinary GDN THD correctness keeps `3e-4`. This aligns duplicate test policy; it does not claim a kernel arithmetic fix.

## Temporary GDN2 parallel quarantine

[Issue #7742](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/issues/7742) tracks intermittent H100 GDN2 hangs across TP4 and CP2 layouts. The latest occurrences exhausted three launcher attempts or GitHub's one-hour job limit. One captured rank stack waits for an Inductor asynchronous backward compilation; the underlying cause remains unresolved.

Mark `test_parallel_gated_delta_net2_correctness` as `flaky_in_dev` in **both** `test_gated_delta_net2.py` and `test_gated_delta_net2_parallel.py`. This temporarily excludes all six parameterizations in each copy from dev CI; the standalone file previously excluded only its two TP4 cases. All six remain eligible in LTS. The other 54 GDN2 module cases and all 139 GDN cases retain their selection behavior. The existing empty-selection handling lets the standalone dev bucket complete successfully.

This contains the known parallel-test stalls; it does not fix the compiler hang. The issue separately records a GDN2 module THD stall, which remains enabled, and the unrelated BF16 GDN padding mismatch addressed above. Re-enable the parallel test after an identified fix passes all six layouts on eight H100 GPUs across repeated cold-cache runs without launcher retries. No compiler setting or timeout is changed here.

## Validation

- The two-bucket implementation previously passed **108 existing CPU tests** covering Testmon mandatory selection and workflow/matrix behavior. Those routing paths are unchanged by the tolerance fix and quarantine.
- Actual before/after pytest collection previously verified **199 → 139 + 60**, with exact mapped node IDs and unchanged effective parameters, fixtures, and existing skip/internal markers, except for the dev-only GDN2 parallel quarantine below. Collection used a temporary architecture-query shim with CUDA unavailable; no GPU fixtures or test bodies executed locally. The tolerance change does not alter collection.
- The padding AST audit verifies the corrected padding method exactly matches the standalone implementation. The shared file's only semantic changes for that fix are the two intended GDN padding tolerance constants. GDN2 and non-padding tolerances remain unchanged.
- Fresh before/after pytest collection for the quarantine preserves all **205 node IDs and their order** across GDN (139), GDN2 (60), and the existing standalone GDN2 parallel file (6). Dev selection excludes exactly the six parallel cases in each GDN2 file; the GDN2 module bucket selects 54 cases, and the standalone bucket selects zero with exit code 0. The LTS marker expression still selects all 205 cases; this checks selection only, not execution in an LTS container. AST checks confirm unchanged test bodies, signatures, and parameter values.
- Repository formatting/lint checks (Black, isort, pylint, Ruff) and `git diff --check` passed for the tolerance fix and quarantine. The autoformat script's optional mypy step was unavailable in the cached CI image.
- **GPU validation of this tolerance fix is pending.** Local GPU access is blocked by an NVIDIA driver/NVML mismatch. Validate the affected case and full GDN bucket on four GB200 GPUs; the earlier passing run is not validation of this new commit.

## Issue tracking

GDN2 parallel quarantine and follow-up diagnostics: #7742 (kept open until the underlying hang is fixed).

Related: #7987 adds compiler-cache reuse for the separate `test_gdn_gated_output_norm_fusion.py` bucket. It does not currently cache this GDN bucket.

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [ ] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] I have added proper typing to my code
- [ ] I have added relevant documentation
- [x] I have run the autoformatter on my PR

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+
+"""Shared test bodies for independently scheduled GDN correctness buckets."""
+
+import copy
+from unittest import mock
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from megatron.core import parallel_state
+from megatron.core.models.gpt.experimental_attention_variant_module_specs import (
+    get_experimental_attention_variant_module_spec,
+)
+from megatron.core.process_groups_config import ProcessGroupCollection
+from megatron.core.ssm.gated_delta_net import (
+    GatedDeltaNet,
+    GatedDeltaNet2,
+    chunk_gdn2,
+    torch_chunk_gated_delta_rule,
+    torch_chunk_gdn2,
+)
+from megatron.core.ssm.gated_delta_net.common import chunk_gated_delta_rule
+from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.random import model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed
+from tests.unit_tests.ssm.gated_delta_net_test_utils import GatedDeltaNetTestBase
+from tests.unit_tests.transformer.test_multi_latent_attention import (
+    make_test_packed_seq_params,
+    make_test_packed_seq_params_with_padding,
+)
+
+try:
+    from causal_conv1d.cpp_functions import causal_conv1d_bwd_function
+except ImportError:
+    HAVE_FUSED_PRE_GDR = False
+else:
+    HAVE_FUSED_PRE_GDR = callable(causal_conv1d_bwd_function)
+
+
+class GatedDeltaNetModuleTestCases(GatedDeltaNetTestBase):
+    """Shared module assertions collected only through variant-specific wrappers."""
+
+    def test_gpu_forward(self):
+        gdn = self.gdn
+
+        micro_batch_size = 2
+        seq_length = 64
+        hidden_states = torch.ones(
+            (seq_length // self.sp_size // self.cp_size, micro_batch_size, gdn.config.hidden_size),
+            device=torch.cuda.current_device(),
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        )
+        attention_mask = None
+
+        output, bias = gdn(hidden_states, attention_mask)
+
+        assert output.dim() == 3, f"Output too many dimensions ({output.shape=})"
+        assert output.shape[0] == seq_length // self.sp_size // self.cp_size, (
+            f"Output shape {output.shape[0]=} mismatch with "
+            f" {seq_length=} // {self.sp_size=} // {self.cp_size=}."
+        )
+        assert (
+            output.shape[1] == micro_batch_size
+        ), f"Output shape {output.shape[1]=} mismatch with {micro_batch_size=}"
+        assert (
+            output.shape[2] == gdn.config.hidden_size
+        ), f"Output shape {output.shape[2]=} mismatch with {gdn.config.hidden_size=}"
+        assert (
+            output.dtype == hidden_states.dtype
+        ), f"Output dtype {output.dtype=} mismatch with {hidden_states.dtype=}"
+
+    def test_gpu_forward_thd_correctness(self):
+        if self.sp_size > 1:
+            pytest.skip("Sequence parallel is not supported for this test case.")
+
+        if self.use_gdn2:
+            # FLA uses different kernels for SBHD and THD:
+            # https://github.com/fla-org/flash-linear-attention/blob/ebf3a0cff2be3e6f2b2f99820b8fe4e28855ced0/fla/ops/gdn2/chunk_intra.py#L40-L53
+            # so we relax the error bound here
+            atol, rtol = 1e-2, 1e-2
+        else:
+            atol, rtol = 3e-4, 3e-4
+
+        # Input shape
+        sequence_length = 32
+        micro_batch_size = 4
+        cu_seqlens = [0, 32, 64, 96, 128]
+        # sbhd input shape: [sequence length, batch size, hidden size]
+        sub_sequence_length = sequence_length // self.cp_size
+        hidden_states_sbhd = torch.rand(
+            (sub_sequence_length, micro_batch_size, self.gdn.config.hidden_size)
+        )
+        attention_mask_sbhd = None
+        hidden_states_sbhd = hidden_states_sbhd.cuda().bfloat16()
+        # thd input shape: [sequence length * batch size, 1, hidden size]
+        hidden_states_thd = hidden_states_sbhd.transpose(0, 1).contiguous()
+        hidden_states_thd = hidden_states_thd.view(-1, 1, self.gdn.config.hidden_size)
+        attention_mask_thd = None
+        packed_seq_params = make_test_packed_seq_params(cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens)
+
+        # THD format
+        output_thd, _ = self.gdn(
+            hidden_states_thd, attention_mask_thd, packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params
+        )
+        # SBHD format
+        output_sbhd, _ = self.gdn(hidden_states_sbhd, attention_mask_sbhd)
+        output_sbhd_T = output_sbhd.transpose(0, 1).contiguous().view(*output_thd.shape)
+
+        rank = torch.distributed.get_rank()
+        assert output_thd.shape[0] == sub_sequence_length * micro_batch_size
+        assert output_thd.shape[1] == 1
+        assert output_thd.shape[2] == self.gdn.config.hidden_size
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            output_sbhd_T,
+            output_thd,
+            atol=atol,
+            rtol=rtol,
+            msg=lambda msg: f"Output mismatch ({rank=}): {msg}",
+        )
+
+    def test_gpu_forward_thd_padding_correctness(self):
+        if self.sp_size > 1:
+            pytest.skip("Sequence parallel is not supported for this test case.")
+
+        if self.use_gdn2:
+            # See test_gpu_forward_thd_correctness: varlen vs batched kernel paths only
+            # match up to bf16 ULP-level differences for GDN2.
+            atol, rtol = 1e-2, 1e-2
+        else:
+            # SBHD and padded THD use distinct FLA bf16 kernel paths, which can
+            # differ by one ULP. Match test_gated_delta_net_padding.py and #6851:
+            # https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/6851#issuecomment-5455230207
+            atol, rtol = 5e-3, 5e-3
+        sequence_length = 32
+        micro_batch_size = 4
+
+        # sbhd input shape: [sequence length, batch size, hidden size]
+        sub_sequence_length = sequence_length // self.cp_size
+        hidden_states_sbhd = torch.rand(
+            (sub_sequence_length, micro_batch_size, self.gdn.config.hidden_size),
+            device=torch.cuda.current_device(),
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        )
+        output_sbhd, _ = self.gdn(hidden_states_sbhd, None)
+
+        # thd input shape: [sequence length * batch size, 1, hidden size]
+        hidden_states_thd = hidden_states_sbhd.transpose(0, 1).contiguous()
+        hidden_states_thd = hidden_states_thd.view(-1, 1, self.gdn.config.hidden_size)
+        output_bshd = output_sbhd.transpose(0, 1).contiguous()
+
+        rank = torch.distributed.get_rank()
+
+        # A) padded branch: prefer *_padded when available.
+        padded_params = make_test_packed_seq_params_with_padding(
+            cu_seqlens=[0, 30, 60, 90, 120], cu_seqlens_padded=[0, 32, 64, 96, 128]
+        )
+        output_thd_padded, _ = self.gdn(hidden_states_thd, None, packed_seq_params=padded_params)
+        output_thd2bshd = output_thd_padded.view(*output_bshd.shape)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            output_bshd[:, :30, :],
+            output_thd2bshd[:, :30, :],
+            atol=atol,
+            rtol=rtol,
+            msg=lambda msg: f"THD padded output mismatch ({rank=}): {msg}",
+        )
+
+        # B) no-padded branch: use actual cu_seqlens when it matches total_sequence_length.
+        no_padding_params = make_test_packed_seq_params(cu_seqlens=[0, 32, 64, 96, 128])
+        output_thd_no_padding, _ = self.gdn(
+            hidden_states_thd, None, packed_seq_params=no_padding_params
+        )
+        assert output_thd_no_padding.shape == output_thd_padded.shape
+
+        # C) padded mismatch branch: if *_padded[-1] mismatches total_sequence_length, should raise.
+        padded_mismatch_params = make_test_packed_seq_params_with_padding(
+            cu_seqlens=[0, 30, 60, 90, 120], cu_seqlens_padded=[0, 32, 64, 96, 126]
+        )
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="does not match"):
+            self.gdn(hidden_states_thd, None, packed_seq_params=padded_mismatch_params)
+
+        # D) actual mismatch branch without *_padded: should raise.
+        actual_mismatch_params = make_test_packed_seq_params(cu_seqlens=[0, 32, 64, 96, 129])
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="does not match"):
+            self.gdn(hidden_states_thd, None, packed_seq_params=actual_mismatch_params)
+
+    def test_selective_recompute_norm_out(self):
+        tp_group = parallel_state.get_tensor_model_parallel_group()
+        cp_group = parallel_state.get_context_parallel_group()
+        pg_collection = ProcessGroupCollection(tp=tp_group, cp=cp_group)
+
+        def build_gdn(config):
+            gdn_spec = get_experimental_attention_variant_module_spec(config=config)
+            gdn = gdn_spec.module(
+                config,
+                submodules=gdn_spec.submodules,
+                layer_number=1,
+                bias=False,
+                conv_bias=False,
+                conv_init=1.0,
+                use_qk_l2norm=True,
+                A_init_range=(1, 16),
+                pg_collection=pg_collection,
+            )
+            return gdn.cuda().bfloat16()
+
+        def run(gdn, hidden_states):
+            output, _ = gdn(hidden_states, None)
+            output.float().sum().backward()
+            grads = {
+                name: param.grad.detach()
+                for name, param in gdn.named_parameters()
+                if param.grad is not None
+            }
+            input_grad = hidden_states.grad.detach().clone()
+            return output.detach(), grads, input_grad
+
+        micro_batch_size = 2
+        seq_length = 64
+        base_config = copy.deepcopy(self.transformer_config)
+        rec_config = copy.deepcopy(self.transformer_config)
+        rec_config.recompute_granularity = "selective"
+        rec_config.recompute_modules = ["gdn_norm_out"]
+
+        model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(42)
+        torch.manual_seed(42)
+        hidden_states = torch.randn(
+            (
+                seq_length // self.sp_size // self.cp_size,
+                micro_batch_size,
+                self.gdn.config.hidden_size,
+            ),
+            device=torch.cuda.current_device(),
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            requires_grad=True,
+        )
+
+        # --- Baseline (no recompute) ---
+        model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(42)
+        torch.manual_seed(42)
+        base_gdn = build_gdn(base_config)
+        assert base_gdn.recompute_norm_out is False
+        base_output, base_grads, base_input_grad = run(base_gdn, hidden_states)
+        hidden_states.grad = None
+        assert base_gdn.norm_out_checkpoint is None
+        del base_gdn
+        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
+
+        # --- Recompute ---
+        model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(42)
+        torch.manual_seed(42)
+        rec_gdn = build_gdn(rec_config)
+        assert rec_gdn.recompute_norm_out is True
+        rec_output, rec_grads, rec_input_grad = run(rec_gdn, hidden_states)
+        assert rec_gdn.norm_out_checkpoint is not None
+
+        rank = torch.distributed.get_rank()
+        assert torch.equal(rec_output, base_output), f"Output not identical ({rank=})"
+        assert torch.equal(rec_input_grad, base_input_grad), f"Input grad not identical ({rank=})"
+        assert set(rec_grads.keys()) == set(base_grads.keys())
+        for name in base_grads:
+            assert torch.equal(
+                rec_grads[name], base_grads[name]
+            ), f"Grad not identical for {name} ({rank=})"
+
+    def test_deterministic_mode(self, monkeypatch):
+        from megatron.core.ssm.gated_delta_net import common
+
+        def reject_autotuned_l2norm(*args, **kwargs):
+            raise AssertionError("Deterministic GDN must not dispatch FLA's autotuned L2 norm")
+
+        monkeypatch.setattr(common, "l2norm", reject_autotuned_l2norm)
+        tp_group = parallel_state.get_tensor_model_parallel_group()
+        cp_group = parallel_state.get_context_parallel_group()
+        pg_collection = ProcessGroupCollection(tp=tp_group, cp=cp_group)
+
+        det_config = copy.deepcopy(self.transformer_config)
+        det_config.deterministic_mode = True
+        det_config.gdn_kernel_backend = "torch"
+
+        gdn_spec = get_experimental_attention_variant_module_spec(config=det_config)
+
+        model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(42)
+        torch.manual_seed(42)
+        gdn = (
+            gdn_spec.module(
+                det_config,
+                submodules=gdn_spec.submodules,
+                layer_number=1,
+                bias=False,
+                conv_bias=False,
+                conv_init=1.0,
+                use_qk_l2norm=True,
+                A_init_range=(1, 16),
+                pg_collection=pg_collection,
+            )
+            .cuda()
+            .bfloat16()
+        )
+
+        # The deterministic configuration explicitly selects the variant's torch-native kernel.
+        assert gdn.gdn_backend == "torch"
+        if self.use_gdn2:
+            assert isinstance(gdn, GatedDeltaNet2)
+            assert gdn.gated_delta_rule is torch_chunk_gdn2
+        else:
+            assert isinstance(gdn, GatedDeltaNet)
+            assert gdn.gated_delta_rule is torch_chunk_gated_delta_rule
+
+        micro_batch_size = 2
+        seq_length = 64
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        base_input = torch.randn(
+            (seq_length // self.sp_size // self.cp_size, micro_batch_size, gdn.config.hidden_size),
+            device=torch.cuda.current_device(),
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        )
+
+        def run(module):
+            hidden_states = base_input.clone().requires_grad_(True)
+            output, _ = module(hidden_states, None)
+            output.float().sum().backward()
+            grads = {
+                name: param.grad.detach().clone()
+                for name, param in module.named_parameters()
+                if param.grad is not None
+            }
+            module.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+            return output.detach().clone(), grads, hidden_states.grad.detach().clone()
+
+        out1, grads1, input_grad1 = run(gdn)
+        out2, grads2, input_grad2 = run(gdn)
+
+        rank = torch.distributed.get_rank()
+        assert torch.equal(out1, out2), f"Output not reproducible ({rank=})"
+        assert torch.equal(input_grad1, input_grad2), f"Input grad not reproducible ({rank=})"
+        assert set(grads1.keys()) == set(grads2.keys())
+        for name in grads1:
+            assert torch.equal(
+                grads1[name], grads2[name]
+            ), f"Grad not reproducible for {name} ({rank=})"
+
+    def test_module_construction(self):
+        gdn = self.gdn
+        if self.use_gdn2:
+            assert isinstance(gdn, GatedDeltaNet2)
+            assert gdn.gated_delta_rule is chunk_gdn2
+            assert gdn.in_proj_dim == 4 * gdn.qk_dim + 3 * gdn.v_dim
+            assert gdn.A_log.shape == (gdn.num_key_heads // self.tp_size,)
